overview.short: Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary is a protected area in Nagaland, India.
overview.description: Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary is a protected area in Nagaland, India. It is situated close to the India-Myanmar border in Pungro circle of Kiphire district, and covers an area of 642 ha (1,590 acres). Fakim village is the gateway to the sanctuary. It was established in 1983.

howToReach.roadNote: Accessible by road from Kohima via Meluri, Kiphire, and Pungro. Sturdy 4WD vehicle recommended during monsoon season.

topPlaces.name: Mount Saramati Peak & Trail
topPlaces.description: Rising to 3,841 metres right above Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary along the India-Myanmar frontier, Mount Saramati is Nagaland's highest peak, revered for its alpine flora, winter snows, and rugged trekking expeditions.

image.alt: Majestic misty alpine peak and rugged trekking trail of Mount Saramati on Nagaland frontier

photos.alt: Scenic misty green mountain ridges surrounding Mount Saramati trail
Dramatic rugged peak shrouded in high altitude Himalayan fog
High altitude mountain slopes and alpine ridges in Nagaland

topPlaces.name: Thanamir Apple Village
topPlaces.description: Known as the Apple Capital of Nagaland, Thanamir is a picturesque Yimkhiung Naga village nestled at the foot of Mount Saramati, serving as the cultural staging camp for visitors to Fakim and the peak.

image.alt: Traditional wooden architecture and rural village life in Fakim village gateway

photos.alt: Traditional hill village settlement and ethnic architecture in Kiphire district
Historic village settlement nestled amidst the green hills of Kiphire
Lush mountain apple orchards and blooming trees in high altitude Naga village

topPlaces.name: Mimi & Salomi Limestone Caves
topPlaces.description: Located in the hills of Kiphire near Fakim, these ancient natural limestone caves feature underground caverns, unique karst rock formations, and colonies of subterranean bats in untouched wild surroundings.

image.alt: Mystic subterranean limestone cavern and massive natural rock formations near Mimi

photos.alt: Underground limestone cavern chambers and mineral stalactites
Dramatic natural cave rock passage and subterranean formations
Karst limestone cave structures and rock formations in Kiphire

topPlaces.name: Pungro Foothills Gateway
topPlaces.description: Pungro is the picturesque sub-divisional hill settlement and primary gateway to Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary and Mount Saramati, offering panoramic views across the eastern Naga ranges.

image.alt: Panoramic winding mountain road and rolling green valley hills of Pungro gateway

Expansive mist-shrouded green hills and ridges of Nagaland

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The best time to visit Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary is Oct – Mar. The winter months offer clear mountain views and pleasant hiking weather.

faq.q: How do I reach Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The nearest airport and major railway station is Dimapur (260 km). From Dimapur or Kohima, take a shared taxi or 4WD vehicle via Meluri to Pungro, which is the gateway to Fakim.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: 3 to 4 days are recommended to explore Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary, visit Thanamir Apple Village, and trek towards Mount Saramati.

faq.q: Where should I stay when visiting Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: Accommodations are available at the Pungro Tourist Lodge, community homestays in Thanamir village, and the Forest Rest House in Kiphire.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit around Fakim Wildlife Sanctuary?
faq.a: The top attractions are Mount Saramati Peak & Trail, Thanamir Apple Village, Mimi & Salomi Limestone Caves, and Pungro Foothills Gateway.
